description: This Java class 'CenterHelper' provides utility methods for managing 'Center' entities within the Fineract integration test suite. It includes functions to create, retrieve, update, activate, delete, and list centers via REST API calls, along with utility methods for JSON payload construction and staff association. The class interacts with the Fineract API endpoints related to centers and appears to facilitate automated testing scenarios.

classes.name: CenterHelper
classes.description: A utility class for performing CRUD operations, listing, and managing 'Center' entities via REST APIs within Fineract integration tests.

methods.name: retrieveByID
methods.description: Fetches a Center entity by its ID from the server, returning a CenterDomain object.

methods.name: paginatedListCenters
methods.description: Retrieves a list of centers with pagination enabled, returning an ArrayList of CenterDomain objects.

methods.name: listCenters
methods.description: Retrieves an unpaginated list of centers, returning an ArrayList of CenterDomain objects.

methods.name: listCentersOrdered
methods.description: Retrieves a list of centers ordered by ID in ascending order, returning an ArrayList of CenterDomain objects.

methods.name: createCenter
methods.description: Creates a new center with specified attributes. Several overloaded versions are present for different parameter combinations.

methods.name: updateCenter
methods.description: Updates center details by ID using a provided HashMap of changes.

methods.name: associateGroups
methods.description: Associates group members with a center by ID.

methods.name: deleteCenter
methods.description: Deletes a center by its ID.

methods.name: verifyCenterCreatedOnServer
methods.description: Checks if a center with a given ID exists on the server.

methods.name: verifyCenterActivatedOnServer
methods.description: Verifies if a center has the expected activation status.

methods.name: activateCenter
methods.description: Activates a center via a server call.

methods.name: getTestCenterWithStaffAsJSON
methods.description: Generates a JSON payload to create a test center with staff assignment capabilities.

methods.name: getTestCenterAsJSON
methods.description: Generates a JSON payload to create a test center with default or specific attributes.

methods.name: assignStaffAsJSON
methods.description: Creates a JSON payload to assign a staff member.

methods.name: unassignStaffAsJSON
methods.description: Creates a JSON payload to unassign a staff member.

methods.name: activateCenterAsJSON
methods.description: Creates a JSON payload to activate a center with an optional activation date.

methods.name: randomNameGenerator
methods.description: Generates a random name string with a given prefix and suffix length.

methods.name: assignStaff
methods.description: Performs a server POST to assign a staff member to a group.

methods.name: unassignStaff
methods.description: Performs a server POST to unassign a staff member from a group.
